footer: Content not in the target language is translated automatically; you can switch back to the original any time. The translation model in Models does the work.
model_default_note: Translation uses the model of the default assistant “{name}”, not the current assistant's.
scope_footer: Lark has a lot of messages, so they aren't translated by default. Only others' messages in the chats picked here are translated.
local_note: These settings are kept in this browser only. Your phone has its own translation settings: the hub translates new mail ahead of time for it, and the web app uses an existing translation when you open a mail.
